instruction: A cinematic outdoor still in a grassy park. In the left foreground, a heavy-set Black man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) holds a blue frisbee and points forward with his hand. Facing him on the right, a woman with dark hair in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) leans forward and points her right arm past him. In the background, a woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6), a man in a red t-shirt (R3), and a woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) watch the exchange under bright daylight. The scene is captured in a medium shot.
